title: Primor Stylish Font
author: Typebae
description:
Discover timeless elegance and refined luxury in every letter with Primor Stylish, a premium font collection designed for designers, creatives, and brands who value sophistication and style. Combining classic beauty with modern features, Primor Stylish offers a versatile trio of luxury serif, italic serif, and handwritten signature script fonts to elevate any high-end design project.
Whether you’re designing for luxury branding, wedding stationery, fashion editorials, or upscale packaging, Primor Stylish brings a polished and graceful look with professional-level features and stunning customizability.
What’s Included in the Primor Stylish Font Collection?
Primor Stylish Serif – Timeless & Elegant
An all-caps serif with timeless charm, available in both Upright and Slanted styles. Uppercase letters feature elegant swashes, perfect for initials, while lowercase offers a simpler caps style. Ideal for luxury branding, headlines and premium logos.
– Character Set: All-caps letters, numerals, punctuation, and multilingual support
– Ligatures: 32 elegant ligatures for smoother letterforms
– Stylistic Alternates: Features small, raised lowercase alternates (A, E, O, U) each placed above a delicate star symbol
– Serif Italic: A refined slanted version adds classic flair and contrast
Primor Stylish Script – Signature & Romantic
A stylish handwritten script with natural flow and a personal touch. Perfect for wedding invites, feminine branding, and signature-style logotypes.
– Character Set: Full uppercase & lowercase, numerals, punctuation, and multilingual support
– Stylistic Alternates: Includes 104 alternates with sweeping entry and exit swashes on lowercase characters
– Connector Style: Features soft extended strokes and heart-shaped connectors for a romantic touch
OpenType Features
All three fonts in the Primor Stylish family are enhanced with OpenType capabilities, including standard ligatures, stylistic alternates, and decorative swashes. With full PUA encoding, every special glyph and alternate character can be used seamlessly across most design platforms—even without advanced software.
Primor Stylish is more than just a font; it’s a statement of elegance. With its rich stylistic options and refined details, this collection gives you the creative freedom to build luxury-driven designs that stand out with beauty and class.
